layout_and_dialog_structure.dialog_layout: Preserve left Section > Category navigation panel, main header, and Close/Save footer.
layout_and_dialog_structure.responsive_fixes: Ensure table container has overflow-x-auto or responsive flex-col/grid stack so Actions column and Add Option / Add Question buttons are never clipped on right edge.

draft_card.title: New question
draft_card.input_field: Multi-line auto-growing Textarea for question text with auto-height or min-rows=2
draft_card.add_to_list_button: Pill or sharp primary button ('Add to list') to commit draft into configured questions list

yes_no_scoring.points_input: Numeric input for points when preferred answer is chosen
yes_no_scoring.max_points_display: Auto-calculated, read-only field or badge equal to preferred answer points

multiple_choice_scoring.option_type: Single-select radio buttons for supplier view
multiple_choice_scoring.add_option_button: Secondary / Outline button with Plus icon ('Add option')
multiple_choice_scoring.max_points_display: Auto-calculated, read-only max score among all options
multiple_choice_scoring.validation_rules: At least 2 options required, no duplicate/empty text, numeric scores >= 0, at least one score > 0

evidence_section.score_dependency_toggle: If Mandatory: Toggle Switch for 'Does the score depend on evidence?' (Yes / No)
evidence_section.penalty_percentage: If Score Dependent: Input field 'If evidence isn't submitted, award [ % ] of points earned' (range 0-100, default 50%)

configured_questions_list.display: Row cards with question text, response type badge, mandatory/evidence tags, points tag
configured_questions_list.actions: Edit, Reorder, Delete with confirmation dialog
configured_questions_list.locking: Locked response type and option scores if supplier responses exist, with warning tooltip/dialog

footer_actions.close_button: Close button with dirty check prompt: 'You have unsaved question changes. Are you sure you want to close?'

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based test IDs on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='question-type-select', data-testid='preferred-answer-toggle', data-testid='add-option-button', data-testid='add-to-list-button', data-testid='save-questions-footer-button')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA contrast ratio (min 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and buttons)

instructions_to_main_agent: Update the 'Add questions' dialog component in ESG supplier assessment without altering backend data contracts or breaking existing questionnaire structure.
Restrict response type selection strictly to 'Yes / No' and 'Multiple choice'.
In Yes/No scoring, implement the Preferred Answer toggle + Points if preferred answer chosen. Set non-preferred score to 0 and auto-calc max points.

In Multiple Choice, implement the options table with drag-to-reorder, option text, score, add option button, and auto-calc max points as highest option score. Validate >= 2 options, no empty/duplicates, numeric scores >= 0, at least one > 0.
In Evidence, replace dropdown with 'Mandatory / Not mandatory' toggle switch, score dependency toggle switch, and customizable percentage penalty field (0-100, default 50).
Implement the 'Draft, not saved' card with 'Add to list' button, moving items to the Configured questions list.
Render Supplier-facing multiple choice questions as single-select radio button groups.
Add explicit confirmation prompt before deleting saved questions and prompt on Close if there are unsaved pending changes.
Ensure table right edge is responsive and non-clipped on all screen sizes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Use generous padding (p-4 to p-8) to avoid cramped UI inside dialogs and tables.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.animations: Micro-interactions for hover, toggle switches, and table reordering.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_hover: Explicit hover text colors when hover background changes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
